name: Bikeep Free Bike Parking at BART
description: Free secure bike parking at select BART stations
fullDescription: Bikeep high-security smart bike racks at seven BART stations provide free secure bike parking. The racks use electronic locking arms with alarms and security monitoring for much better theft protection than a U-lock alone.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free secure bike parking at 16th St Mission, 24th St Mission, 12th St Oakland, MacArthur, Concord, Pleasant Hill, and Union City BART
- Smart locking arm secures frame and one wheel
- 24-hour maximum continuous parking
- Industrial-grade security with alarm system
- Works with a registered physical Clipper card (not the Clipper mobile app)
howToGetIt:
1. Register online with BikeHub (takes about 30 seconds)
2. Link your physical Clipper card to your account
3. Find an available Bikeep rack at the station
4. Tap your Clipper card to lock your bike; use a personal lock for your other wheel
5. Tap again to unlock when returning
keywords: Bikeep, free bike parking, BART, secure, Clipper, smart rack, bicycle, bike commute, BikeHub
